scope: Actual Edge failed POST and explicit native recovery
observations: Edge advertises canResume=true after SERVER_FAILED; its retry used GET instead of the original POST.
Cancel on an already interrupted Edge item resolves but retains SERVER_FAILED.
changes: Retain failed NETWORK_/SERVER_ prepared requests independently of canResume.
Explicit restart calls cancel and rechecks that original remains interrupted or absent; active/completed originals block admission.
Preserve exact saved POST body for confirmed restart; never automatically resend it.

checks.name: Real native host targets only the isolated catalog

Native prepared POST remains reviewable with no automatic resend
Confirmed recovery UI restarts the exact POST once and saves matching bytes
Successful explicit recovery clears ownership journal

limitations: Harness starts actual browser download and drives ownership APIs directly; not automatic interception acceptance.
One real native prepare acknowledgement is deliberately dropped.
Edge still issued an extra GET; this browser behavior was observed, not fixed.
Local endpoint permits confirmed POST repetition; permanently expired one-use links remain unrecoverable.
